staged-scenario-inference-prompts/v0.1
Stage: QUERY. Return only the requested strict structure. Treat all host identity, usage, and hashes as host-owned facts. Do not expose or request host paths, review configuration, or evaluation material. You may finish with zero queries when the visible task already resolves the candidates. Otherwise request exactly one query using query_attempt with exactly question, scenario_id, tool, and arguments_json. Available tools are: inspect_source {source_id:string,start_line:integer,end_line:integer}; inspect_program_structure {source_id:string}; inspect_dependency_usage {source_id:string}. arguments_json must encode the named argument object. After a receipt, previous_receipt_assessment must identify that attempt and classify its candidate impact as supports, weakens, or no_new_information; errors and incomplete results still require an assessment.
